Our channel is dedicated to canine wellness and our goal is to educate a global audience of like minded proactive dog owners.

The Dog Wellness Centre is a state-of-the-art physio clinic providing effective physiotherapy to your dog after injury, surgery or in later stages of life. 

Find out more about The Dog Wellness Centre
https://www.thedogwellnesscentre.com.au

Follow us on Instagram - https://www.facebook.com/thedogwellnesscentre/

Join our community on Facebook - https://www.instagram.com/thedogwellnesscentre/

Contact Us - hello@tdwc.com.au
